Le soleil clignote : l'orbite intérieure: The sun is blinking: the inner orbit will burn. The longer you hold, the faster the ship and the asteroids go.
Rien n'est synchronisé : tes records res: Nothing is synced: your records stay on this device.
↑ ou clic : dehors · ↓ ou clic droit : d: ↑ or click: outward · ↓ or right click: inward · ← brake · → boost · X: fire · P: pause
Toutes les 40 secondes, un nouveau systè: Every 40 seconds, a new star system: red dwarf, pulsar, blue giant… Orbits stretch into ellipses, and some spin. Hold → to boost (it uses energy, but points count double) or ← to brake. Power-ups on the orbits: shield (one hit), magnet (crystals come to you), slow-mo (asteroids drag) and cannon (5 shots with X, 5 points per asteroid destroyed).
Jeu d'adresse au doigt : ton vaisseau to: A one-finger skill game: your ship circles a sun on its own over three orbits, and you only choose which one by tapping far from or near the sun. Dodge asteroids crossing the screen, leave the inner orbit when the sun blinks before a flare, and collect crystals in a row for a multiplier up to ×5. The speed rises; record and statistics are kept. Full screen and a game that fits the screen. Star systems with elliptical orbits, a boost, a brake, a cannon and four power-ups.
Touche loin du soleil : dehors · près :: Tap far from the sun: outward · near: inward · BRAKE, FIRE, BOOST under the game
Toutes les 40 secondes, un nouveau systè: Every 40 seconds, a new star system: red dwarf, pulsar, blue giant… Orbits stretch into ellipses, and some of them turn. Hold BOOST (it uses energy, but points count double) or BRAKE to slow down. Power-ups on the orbits: shield (one hit), magnet (crystals come to you), slow motion (asteroids drag) and cannon (5 shots with FIRE, 5 points per asteroid destroyed).
